mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0%, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are negative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days are negative.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 3.5% fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines in a high-unemployment regime.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in residential housing starts (HOUST) over the past month is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST has risen over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days are negative.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is declining and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days are negative.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-real-sales regime (RSAFS > 700,000), a decline in real sales (RSAFS) over the past month is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines in a high-real-sales regime.
